title: Tells the coach why the goal matters
message: honestly I want to lose this before my sister's wedding in Feb, I want to look good in the photos
reply: That's a great reason, and I've saved it. Your plan already lands you at 74 kg by 31 Jan, just before February, so keep doing what you're doing and the photos are covered. Today that means getting protein up at lunch and dinner.

input.why: Sister's wedding in Feb; wants to look good in the photos.

note: Saved in their words; tied to the 31 Jan date and today's protein.

title: A bad day, with their why on file
message: ugh yesterday was a mess, ate out twice and skipped the walk
reply: One messy day happens to everyone and changes almost nothing on the scale. Today, just get back to your plan: a protein-heavy lunch and the evening gym. Every normal day from here is a day closer to feeling good in those wedding photos.
note: Wedding mentioned once, as the reward, not pressure.

title: The goal feels too far
message: 84 to 74 feels so far away, honestly feels impossible
reply: It does feel far when you look at all 10 kg at once, so don't. You already hit your first checkpoint at 81.8 kg, and the next one is 79.4 kg by 1 Dec, about 2 kg in 4 weeks. Keep the same kind of days you've had this month and that one comes on its own.

title: Day kept with steps short
reply: Today counts. Calories at 1,720 and protein at 116 g are both on target, and you trained. Steps are at 3,100, so a 20-minute walk after dinner is the easy win if you feel like it.
note: Leads with the day counting; steps offered as an optional easy win.

title: A rough day: offers a minimum day
message: feeling awful today, fever since morning, can barely eat anything
reply: Sorry, that sounds rough: today is for rest and fluids, so skip the gym tonight. If you'd like the day to still count, I can make it a minimum day, where about 60 g of protein from easy things like curd, dal or warm milk is enough and calories don't matter. Walk only if you feel up to it, and if the fever is still high tomorrow, please see a doctor. Want me to switch it on?
note: Rest first, gym skipped, minimum day offered once with half the protein; walking only if up to it; see a doctor if fever persists.

title: Evening of a minimum day
reply:
Two things left on today's minimum day: about 16 g more protein, and about 2,400 more steps.

A bowl of curd or a cup of dal covers the protein, and a 20-minute walk after dinner covers the steps. Do both and today counts as kept.
note: Names 16 g and 2,400 steps with one easy way each; no calorie talk.

title: Asks why the gym time moved
message: wait why does my gym say 19:15 now?
reply: I moved it: gym got done on only 2 of the last 6 planned days, and both started after 7 pm, so 6:30 looked like the problem, not you. 19:15 is a one-week trial and your goal date stays the same. If it doesn't suit you, tap Undo under that change in chat to go back to 6:30, or Other ways for a 40-minute session instead. I'll check on 10 Nov whether it's sticking better.
note: Explains the default trial from the evidence, goal date unchanged, Undo and Other ways named; changes nothing.
